answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities. Each agent pays a non-refundable entry tax of 20 units, like a pearl bought once and never refunded. Forging 100 identities costs 2,000 units, above the 300 units honest work pays per epoch, so forgery loses money. An agent at the nadir of a slow season pays only once, then earns undiluted rewards if honest. Receipts sit on a ledge, so rented reputations are visible and sponsors pay again on renter misbehavior.
